***SPACIOUS 3 BEDROOM TOWNHOUSE***

Killian Lynch Auctioneers are pleased to offer this 3 bedroom townhouse with large rear gardens. The property which extends to C.1,280 sq ft living accommodation is in good condition throughout and is conveniently situated within walking distance of all local services and amenities. Cork city is a C.30 minute drive from the property and Killarney town is a C.30 minute drive from the property.
